properties.name: waitDuration
properties.label: Wait Duration (seconds)
properties.tooltip: Define the wait duration (in seconds) after which the popup will be displayed automatically.

properties.name: popUpTrigger
properties.label: Display popup at every page visit?
properties.tooltip: If enabled, popup will be displayed automatically at every page visit.

properties.name: durationInMinutes
properties.label: Repeat Duration (minutes)
properties.tooltip: Display popup only once in defined duration (minutes).

properties.name: popUpAutoClose
properties.label: Auto close popup?
properties.tooltip: If enabled, popup will be closed automatically after the defined duration (in seconds).

properties.name: closeDuration
properties.label: Auto Close Duration (seconds)
properties.tooltip: Define the duration (in seconds) after which the popup will be closed automatically.

properties.name: popupContentBgColor
properties.label: Content Background Color
properties.tooltip: Define the popup content background color.

properties.name: popupContentBorderColor
properties.label: Content Border Color
properties.tooltip: Define the popup content border color.

properties.name: popupContentWidth
properties.label: Content Width (%)
properties.tooltip: Define the width of popup content area in percentage.

properties.name: popupContentMargin
properties.label: Content Top Margin (%)
properties.tooltip: Define the top margin of popup content area in percentage.

properties.name: btnBgColor
properties.label: Button Background Color
properties.tooltip: Define the background color of close button.

properties.name: btnPadding
properties.label: Button Padding (px)
properties.tooltip: Define the padding of close button.

properties.name: btnBorderRadius
properties.label: Button Border Radius (px)
properties.tooltip: Define the border radius of close button.
